title: Hold a food safety scheme accreditation
what: Carry out primary production activities covered by a food safety scheme (such as meat, dairy, egg or horticulture produce) only under an accreditation.

sources.title: Primary Produce Safety Act 2011 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not engage in any primary production activity to which a food safety scheme applies other than under a valid accreditation where such accreditation is required by the scheme

reach.condition: if a food safety scheme applies to its primary produce (such as meat, dairy, seafood or eggs)
